book.title: 林伯洛斯特的女孩
book.author: 吉恩·斯特拉顿-波特 (Gene Stratton-Porter)

special_risk_notes: Long public-domain novel with sustained dialogue, nature description, and period social context.
Character nicknames, moth terminology, and 1900s Midwestern social codes require consistency.
No figure, table, or formula reconstruction load.

difficulty_rationale: The book is a long public-domain novel rather than a technical text, but it mixes literary narration, dialogue, recurring insect terminology, and period social nuance. The main difficulty lies in maintaining natural zh-Hans novel prose while preserving factual and terminological precision across the whole book.

historical_reference.history_usage_note: Uses only publishable output/release/translation_metrics.json files with PASS estimates and PASS actuals. Private-use projects and metrics containing source text or prompt text are ignored.

model_recommendations.recommended_for: broad draft translation and terminology expansion
cost_control_notes: Use for broad drafting only after sample quality proves acceptable.
quality_risk_notes: Watch for term drift and semi-literal prose in emotional dialogue.

model_recommendations.recommended_for: chapter control, difficult passages, and final release QA
cost_control_notes: Reserve for difficult chapters, defect-family cleanup, and release-facing passes.
quality_risk_notes: Do not accept fluent but slightly stiff prose as final publication quality.

model_recommendations.recommended_for: independent long-context review and comparative QA
cost_control_notes: Prefer targeted comparative review over full duplicate passes.
quality_risk_notes: Require explicit issue rows and source-supported reasoning.

cost_quality_strategy: Use medium-tier drafting only when later expert review is guaranteed.
Escalate all recurring defect families to high-tier review.
Spend final tokens on whole-chapter control, post-EPUB family hunting, and release validation.
